=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
Requirement: "Refuse [unsupported conflicted paths] through the existing resolver-failure path (conflict_resolver_failed, retry state, and eventually ai:resolver-escalated)." Also: isolation failures (sandbox_cleanup_failed, transfer_rollback_failed, sandbox_path_unsupported, sandbox_support_missing) must count toward retry-state escalation for integration-sync PRs so the resolver escape valve can fire without a human. The PR description and AD-1/AD-2 both require that every isolation failure integrates with retry-state tracking.
Expected change site: scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh, the _persist_resolver_retry_state_from_current_failure function near line 1879, or in _resolver_fail_closed upstream of that call.
Evidence of absence: _resolver_fail_closed calls _persist_resolver_retry_state_from_current_failure, but that function returns 0 without persisting anything unless RESOLVER_FP_EXIT=1 or RESOLVER_FP_VERIFICATION_TIER=warn_only (line 1879). RESOLVER_FP_EXIT starts at 0 (line 1311) and RESOLVER_FP_VERIFICATION_TIER starts at strict (line 977). The unsupported-path refusal happens before either model execution or fingerprint verification, and sandbox cleanup/rollback failures happen after the model runs but still ahead of fingerprint verification in the retry-loop body. In all cases the guard fires and no retry state is persisted. The LAST RUN DIFF correctly routes cleanup/rollback exits through _resolver_fail_closed instead of bare exit 1, but the underlying guard means the database of failed attempts stays empty for every isolation failure on an integration-sync PR. After INTEGRATION_SYNC_RESOLVER_MAX_ATTEMPTS runs without persisting a single failure, the project reaches ai:resolver-escalated only because the per-run attempt counter exhausts, not because the cross-run retry-state threshold accumulates.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

Requirement: AD-2 (clarify comment 5999684172, Q2): "Refuse it: don't run any model, and end the attempt through the existing resolver-failure path (`conflict_resolver_failed`, retry state, and eventually `ai:resolver-escalated`)." The PR description and `changelog.d/6397-conflict-resolver-sandbox-only.md` restate this: "unsupported conflict paths are refused before any model runs and count toward integration-sync resolver escalation."
Expected change site: `scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh` near the unsupported-path guard at line 2245-2247 and the cleanup/rollback exits at lines 2281/2295, plus the retry-state persistence gate at line 1879.
Evidence of absence: Both refusal sites call `_resolver_fail_closed`, which calls `_persist_resolver_retry_state_from_current_failure`. That helper short-circuits at line 1879 unless `RESOLVER_FP_EXIT=1` or `RESOLVER_FP_VERIFICATION_TIER=warn_only`. The defaults are `RESOLVER_FP_EXIT=0` (line 1311) and `RESOLVER_FP_VERIFICATION_TIER=strict` (line 977). Neither condition is satisfied at the refusal sites because fingerprint verification has not yet run. The helper returns at line 1880 without persisting state, so no `AUTOFIX_RESOLVER_RETRY_STATE_V1` block is written and no escalation counter advances. The new test stubs the helper, masking the gap. The agents.md and changelog claims about "counted toward" escalation are not realized in the code path.

Evidence of absence: The unsupported-path guard calls `_resolver_fail_closed sandbox_path_unsupported`, which invokes `_persist_resolver_retry_state_from_current_failure`. However, that function has a guard at line 1879 that returns early unless `RESOLVER_FP_EXIT=1` OR `RESOLVER_FP_VERIFICATION_TIER=warn_only`. The test `test_unsupported_path_refuses_before_any_model` stubs `_persist_resolver_retry_state_from_current_failure` rather than exercising the real persistence logic, so it does not catch this gap. The LAST RUN DIFF addressed cleanup/rollback failures inside `_resolver_sandbox_opencode_attempt` but did not fix the unsupported-path guard's persistence gap.
